gen.title: Comparing AI research areas and their uses

values.value: learn to see and interpret simple patterns and objects
values.quote: Computer vision emerged in the early 1960s as researchers began exploring whether machines could learn to see and interpret simple patterns and objects.
By the mid-1960s, NSF-funded researchers were developing tools to detect edges in images and algorithms to recognize lines, shapes and simple patterns.

values.value: train and test deep learning systems
values.quote: Researchers use large, high-quality image datasets to train and test deep learning systems, helping them compare and improve computer vision models.

values.value: compare and improve computer vision models
values.quote: helping them compare and improve computer vision models.
stochastic modeling is the idea of capturing real-world randomness mathematically.
Today, stochastic modeling underpins technologies like GPS traffic routing, internet congestion management and speech recognition systems.
